headline: Ministry of Power Guidelines: No Renewable Energy Projects Within One Km of Border, Home Ministry Decision - dainiktribuneonline.com
summary: India's Union Home Ministry issued guidelines banning new solar, wind and hybrid renewable energy projects within one kilometre of the Line of Control, the Line of Actual Control and the international border.
why: Solar and wind developers depend on available land and approvals, so restrictions on siting shape project pipelines in India's fast-growing renewable energy sector.
